conversation.title: A problem at the hotel front desk
conversation.goal: Tell Ana the problem, say how it affects you, and agree on one next step.

turns.text: Hello, I have a problem. The room is not clean and I want other room, please.
I am sorry to hear that. Is the room cold?
Thank you. Do you want to leave this room today, or wait?
I want leave the room today, please. I want other room.
Okay, I can find you a new room. Is the room cold?
Good. What kind of room do you want, small or big?
A big room, please. Sorry, my English is not good.
Don't worry, your English is fine. Is the heater broken?
No, the heater is not broken. The room is just not clean. Sorry.
I am sorry about that. Do you want a new room, or a clean room now?
I want a new room, please. I can not sleep because the room is dirty and smell bad.
I can move you today. Is one hour okay?
Yes, one hour is okay. Thank you very much.
Good. I move you in one hour.

judge.voice: Sorry, my English is not perfect, but I tell honestly. The help buttons are good: I press, it says the question more simply, and I can choose a phrase. Nobody makes me feel stupid, and nothing is bad for Tomáš or Klára. I liked "another room" — I can use it. But Ana asked me three times "Is the room cold?" when I said the room is dirty. Like a guest who is not listened to! The help said "the heater does not work", not my problem. Then I did the same mistake again after coaching, and nobody noticed "I want leave" or "smell bad". I would use it fifteen minutes in the evening, but I would not fully trust the corrections yet. Better than expensive course for a short practice, yes.
